a2-review-3.R3.1 A goodbye dinner for Ana:
Narrator: It's Saturday evening in Chicago. Tomorrow Ana is flying home to São Paulo, so Tom, Lucy and Kate are having a goodbye dinner for her at Tom and Lucy's apartment. Kate has brought Pepper, her dog.
Ana: Oh, Pepper is so cute! You know, I used to be scared of dogs when I was a child. Then we got Mel, and I loved her.
Kate: Pepper used to be really shy, but now she's very friendly. Hey, Pepper, no! Leave the chicken!
Tom: Ha! While we were talking, she was stealing our dinner!
Lucy: So, Ana, what was your favorite thing in Chicago?
Ana: Definitely the Cubs game. If I lived here, I'd go to every game!
Tom: And if they won more often, I'd be a much happier man!
Lucy: What about the food? Is deep-dish pizza better than Brazilian pizza?
Ana: Hmm. It's much bigger and a lot heavier! But Brazilian pizza is the best, of course.
Kate: I brought dessert. It's my new ice cream. I'm probably going to sell it at the bakery this summer.
Ana: Wow, this is amazing! What flavor is it?
Kate: Coffee. I made it with black coffee, so it's a bit stronger than normal coffee ice cream.
Lucy: Kate always makes everything so carefully.
Ana: Tom, who's Priya? I saw her name on the door.
Tom: She's our new roommate. She's a medical student. She's really smart and so polite, but she's a little too busy. She's always at the library!
Lucy: By the way, Ana, did you watch Kingdom of Fire last night?
Ana: Yes! I was so shocked by the ending! When the princess said, "I'm your sister!", I screamed!
Tom: Oh, please, no spoilers! I haven't seen it yet.
Kate: So, Ana, what time is your flight tomorrow?
Ana: It's at five, but I need to be at the airport three hours before. It's an international flight.
Tom: Don't worry. We'll take you to O'Hare. Did you pack your bag yourself?
Ana: Ha! You sound like a check-in agent! Yes, I did.
Lucy: We're really going to miss you, Ana.
Ana: I'll miss you too. And I'm definitely coming back next year!

Ana: To São Paulo.
Agent: May I see your passport, please?
Ana: Here you are.
Agent: Thank you. Place your bag on the scale, please.
Ana: Could I have a window seat, please?
Agent: Sure. Here's your boarding pass. Your gate is M12.
Ana: Sorry, which gate?
Agent: M12. Have a good flight!
Narrator: Dialogue two.
Lucy: Did you watch Fix My House last night?
Kate: Yes! I was really interested in the new kitchen.
Lucy: Me too. But the show was a bit boring this week.

Lucy: Yes! It was the best show of the year.
